notes: Medium. The agent must build a reusable combined key+certificate PEM bundler that tolerates PKCS#8, traditional RSA and SEC1 EC key formats, skips non-PEM noise, verifies key/cert public-key equality via the openssl CLI (refusing mismatched pairs without creating output), emits key-block-then-cert-block with clean newline separation and mode 0600; and must provision the provided edge service by choosing the key that actually matches edge.crt (a retired decoy key is present to punish blind concatenation) plus a sha256 provenance record. The verifier re-runs the tool on 3 fresh hidden scenarios (PKCS#8 RSA, EC, noisy CRLF input) and a mismatched refusal case, recomputing all expectations with openssl. Rubric nonzero for tool_breadth (openssl CLI), adversarial_inputs (decoy key, noisy/CRLF input, mismatch refusal), hidden_case_generalization and reasoning_depth (public-key matching logic).
